text: 1971 adds a Gecko-derived remote-permissions JSON dump and registers its filename in Thunderbird moz.build. 1975 restores both owned paths exactly; context-only 2020 re-adds the same JSON blob and filename. Accepted packaging still lists it. The reported test failure has no verified diagnosis here. Imported permission entries do not establish a new Thunderbird security or style rule. These observations are scoped to the cited accepted source and historical changes. Full Bugzilla and historical review timeline/inline discussion remain pending. No Thunderbird runtime, build, lint or live accessibility check was run.
title: Distinguish a copied settings dump from owned packaging logic
